name: Tsukaima Ikusei Project
original_name: 使い魔育成プロジェクト
source:
The main character, Raoul Garland, is a magician. He uses "contracted" monsters to fight evil monsters.

For various reasons, he aspired to become the most important magician, a Guardian, and challenged an unprecedented attempt to train a half-human, half-witch-beast familiar with his own hands.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ178266.html]DLsite[/url]]
